summary: 1-800-FLOWERS.COM filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026, reporting a Third Amendment to its June 27, 2023 credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent. The amendment replaces financial covenants with a minimum liquidity test until the fiscal quarter ending September 26, 2027, then a minimum consolidated EBITDA covenant thereafter. It expands asset-sale permissions, allowing retention of up to $30.0 million in proceeds after at least $15.0 million prepayment of the term loan, restricts IP transfers, and requires monthly lender calls. No special-situation transaction or board recommendation is involved. This is a routine credit-facility amendment; watch covenant compliance and liquidity.
